title: Telephone

scenario.title: Fuzzing a parser with mutated input
scenario.body: Feeding a program slightly broken input ("fuzzing") finds the crashes nobody thought to test. A fuzzer is only useful if it actually changes something and keeps the shape of the input. The book's round() turns 10% of a short word into zero changes, and it happily turns line breaks into letters, so a CSV file collapses into one line. Keep every seeded answer the author expects and fix both.

character.name: Mumbles
character.role: a hamster who is a little hard of hearing

tagline: Whisper a message to Mumbles the hamster and Mumbles passes it on, getting a few letters wrong. Turn up the noise for more mistakes. Same lucky number, same mistakes.

brain_blurbs.book: Changes a share of the letters, rounding the share to a whole number.
brain_blurbs.real: Always makes at least one mistake when asked, and never muddles up the lines.

rules.test_usage: Explains itself when you ask for help (or say nothing)
rules.test_bad_seed_str: The lucky number has to be a whole number
rules.test_bad_mutation_str: The noise level has to be a number
rules.test_for_echo: With no noise, Mumbles hears it perfectly
rules.test_now_cmd_s1: Lucky number 1: exactly the book's mistakes
rules.test_now_cmd_s2_m4: Lucky number 2, lots of noise: exactly the book's mistakes
rules.test_fox_file_s1: Can read the message from a file
rules.test_fox_file_s2_m6: …with exactly the book's mistakes for lucky number 2
rules.test_short_message_still_changes: A tiny message still gets at least one mistake
rules.test_half_rounds_the_same_way: Half a mistake rounds up to one
rules.test_line_breaks_stay_put: Lines stay lines: no line break turns into a letter
rules.test_exact_number_of_mistakes: 40% noise on 20 letters is exactly 8 mistakes
rules.test_same_seed_same_mistakes: Same lucky number, same mistakes, every time
rules.test_same_length: Any message: it never grows or shrinks
rules.test_some_change_whenever_asked: Any noise above zero makes at least one mistake
rules.test_newlines_never_move: Line breaks are always exactly where they were
rules.test_zero_changes_nothing: No noise: a perfect echo, every time
